case_title: State of Maharashtra v. Vishwanath Maranna Shetty
accused_occupation: Managing funds of an organized crime syndicate
evidence_type: Confessional statement, statement of employee, investigation records
confession: Confession made by co-accused recorded under MCOCA s. 18
aggravating_circumstances: Involvement in organized crime syndicate, abetment of murder
neutral_facts: The accused was part of an organized crime syndicate involved in the murder of a victim. The prosecution alleged that the accused facilitated the transfer of funds from a builder to the actual killers. The accused was denied bail by the Special Court, but the High Court granted bail. The Supreme Court overturned the High Court's decision, stating that the materials against the accused included a confession from a co-accused and evidence of the accused's involvement in the illegal transactions. The accused was found to have received ill-gotten money for the syndicate and was involved in the abetment of the murder.
